CustomField.label: Days overdue
CustomField.description: SCRUM-468: how many days a Lent_Out device is past its due date, blank when it is not overdue. System-computed, read-only; the overdue report sorts on it descending (AC8).
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(TEXT(Status__c) = "Lent_Out", NOT(ISBLANK(Current_Loan_Due_Date__c))), IF(Current_Loan_Due_Date__c < TODAY(), TODAY() - Current_Loan_Due_Date__c, null), null)
